description: This Java class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for OTA packages in the Thingsboard platform, implementing methods for querying and managing OTA package data in a SQL database.

classes.name: JpaOtaPackageDao
classes.description: A DAO class for OTA packages, providing database operations such as find, sum, and unlink for OTA package entities.

methods.name: sumDataSizeByTenantId
methods.description: Calculates the total data size of OTA packages for a given tenant.

methods.name: findOtaPackageByTenantIdAndTitleAndVersion
methods.description: Finds an OTA package by tenant ID, title, and version.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all OTA packages for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves OTA packages for a tenant by UUID with pagination.

methods.name: findIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves OTA package IDs for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds an OTA package by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: getDataOidById
methods.description: Gets the data object ID associated with an OTA package by its UUID.

methods.name: unlinkLargeObject
methods.description: Unlinks a large object (e.g., binary data) by its data object ID.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for an OTA package given its internal ID.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JPA repository used for database operations.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is OTA_PACKAGE.
